Chapter 648: Chapter 2: The Supreme Being'S Surprise (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 648: Chapter 2: The Supreme Being’s Surprise (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

That was where the strongest of the Ten Thousand Races of the Cosmic Starry Sky converged; a place where even the rarely seen Ninth and Tenth Rank powerhouses would gather.

Even Eleventh Rank powerhouses would occasionally appear.

However, unless absolutely necessary, Eleventh Rank powerhouses would not attack each other, and a collision among Supreme Beings was even rarer, perhaps once in tens of thousands of years.

So far, the most recent time Supreme Beings had fought each other was decades ago, involving the corpse of a Supreme Being from beyond the universe.

“After stepping into the Tenth Rank, even on large battlefields, I will have the power to protect myself,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

If he were only at the Ninth Rank, it would still be somewhat risky, as some special Eleventh Rank powerhouses could completely deploy the Curse-Killing Skill.

...

At the Tenth Rank, it was much safer. According to the principle that at least crossing two Great Realms was needed to perform a Curse-Killing, at least a Supreme Being could curse-kill a Tenth Rank life.

And if an alien Supreme Being took action, a human civilization’s Supreme Being would certainly intervene.

Under such balance, Lin Yuan would at most lose an avatar. The true body would not be affected at all.

“I wonder, on the large alien battlefield’s Eternal Spatial Rift, how much the efficiency of accumulating World-Breaking Origin Force will increase?”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat expectant.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan met with Duoke and other special Ninth Rank beings.

“Galaxy Master, some Ninth Rank Different Species that have been pushed to the inner area are willing to pay all the spoils of this secret realm just for their avatars to be able to leave the realm,”

spoke Duoke.

The Ninth Rank Different Species being hunted by human civilization’s Evolvers mainly composed of the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, and other Peak Clans, yet still included some powerful clans and special life-form powerhouses.

These Ninth Rank Different Species had found themselves on the human civilization’s hit list solely due to being dragged down by Peak Clans.

Now, with the situation in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm fully clarified under the suppression of the Galaxy Master, these Ninth Rank Different Species had no chance at all.

Under these circumstances, a small portion of the Ninth Rank Different Species naturally wanted to show submission to human civilization just to keep their avatars alive.

For many clans, a Ninth Rank powerhouse was a pillar of support; losing an avatar would have a significant impact on their clans.

“Since you chose to ally with the Insect Race, Tianyu Clan, you should have known the consequences,” Lin Yuan said calmly.

Pay all the spoils of this journey to the secret realm?

Even if they didn’t pay, once the secret realm closed, everything would belong to Lin Yuan anyway.

He could even obtain your physical essence blood. The essence blood of a Ninth Rank powerhouse is already comparable to many cosmic Rare Treasures.

“Good.”

Revitalized, Duoke’s expression lifted.

This was the Galaxy Master, the strongest genius in human civilization’s history.

He didn’t compromise with Different Species at all, preferring to forsake any gains just to make those Different Species suffer.

…

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan stopped absorbing the purple liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd.

One reason was that the continuous incineration of his body into ashes was also a kind of loss to himself.

Another was that the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd wasn’t unlimited; it could only condense some amount every once in a while.

“Delve into the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan turned to delve into the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path.

Located in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the Taiyang Divine Spirit was practicing the “Mysterious Yellow Strike” and “Xuanhuang Physique.”

Located on the alien battlefield, the Taiyin Primordial Spirit was delving into the Rule of Time, practicing “Steps of Time-Space.”

Based on the Milky Way Main Star, his true form was reflecting on various Evolution Paths, while also comparing with the Chaos Crystal and Miniature Universe, mutually verifying with his own body.

The three main avatars each focused on different points.

“Xuan Huang Evolution… truly wonderful; the Tenth and Eleventh Stage Volume are drastically different from the Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths of our current human civilization.”

Immersed in deep contemplation, Lin Yuan found that the deeper he delved into the Xuan Huang Evolutionary Path, the more he could enhance the practice of “Mysterious Yellow Strike” and “Primordial Yellow Physique.”

And his reflection on “Steps of Time-Space” could foster insights into the Space Rules and Rule of Time.

Various flashes of spiritual light intertwined, driven by his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, Lin Yuan was elevating at an unimaginable speed.

“From Ninth to Tenth Rank, it belongs to a slow transformation process that cannot be accomplished overnight,” Lin Yuan mused, while also paying attention to his own transformation.

A Ninth Rank powerhouse had at least developed millions of Spatial Layers; to transform all of these layers at once wasn’t something that could be done in a short time.

“Given my current situation, once the transformation begins, it will probably take about a hundred years to complete,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Other Ninth Rank powerhouses trying to break through to the Tenth Rank would be extremely cautious during their transformation period, paying constant attention to the changes in their inner worlds and multi-layered spatial transformations.

They would occasionally need adjustments.

But Lin Yuan didn’t need to care about these things at all; with his vast inner world and profound spatial depth, once his foundation reached a certain level, the so-called transformation was natural.

“A hundred years…” Lin Yuan’s expression was slightly emotional.

The time he had spent in the Main Universe totaled just over a hundred years, and now a single breakthrough transformation was going to take a hundred years.

“This hundred years, I won’t carry out any travel,” Lin Yuan decided in his mind.

At his current level, blind traveling wasn’t very useful; it was better to reach the Tenth Rank first before considering specific travel plans.

During this hundred years, it would be ideal to accumulate a large amount of World-Breaking Origin Force. The various travel methods through the Door to the Myriad Realms, the ‘customized’ traversal made Lin Yuan quite curious.

Provided there was sufficient World-Breaking Origin Force, Lin Yuan didn’t mind undertaking a ‘customized’ traversal.

The prerequisite was that it could provide him with significant aid, at least the kind he could not obtain within the Main World.
